claims: Disneyland ticket prices for 2026 range from $104 to over $224 for a 1-day, 1-park ticket based on demand using a 7-tier system.
Disneyland ticket prices increased in October 2025.
Disneyland kept the base price at $104 in the October 2025 price increase.
Disneyland raised peak days prices in the October 2025 price increase.
Disneyland 1-Day, 1-Park tickets for adults 10+ range from $104 (Tier 0) to $224 (Tier 6) in 2026.
Disneyland Park Hopper ticket adds $70–$90 per day to base tickets.
Disneyland multi-day tickets range from 2-day ($235+) up to 5-day options.
Disneyland standard parking is $30 per day.
Children ages 3–9 can visit Disneyland for $50 per day with a 1-Day Park Hopper ticket from May 22 to September 7, 2026.
Magic Key Passes prices are increasing in late 2025.
A theme park reservation is required in addition to a ticket for entry at Disneyland.
